summary: Fixed race condition in concurrent add operations by implementing file locking using fcntl.flock. Added atomic_add() method that acquires exclusive lock during load-modify-save sequence.
risks: fcntl is Unix-specific; Windows uses different locking mechanism (msvcrt.locking)
Lock file (.lock) is created alongside data file; cleanup is not automatic
limitations: File locking is advisory; processes not using atomic_add() can still cause races
Lock files persist after process exit (though locks are released)
